currentWork.title: FINAL.37 production verified; AN15 learned numeric promotion remains paused
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.37 is merged, deployed, and live-verified. Normal project state returns to the intentionally paused AN15 evidence/promotion gate.
releaseScope: Highway ON first evaluates normal ORS driving-hgv alternatives.
When normal candidates still contain insufficient motorway use, VENDRIVE actively queries nearby OSM motorway junctions through Overpass.
At most two plausible entry/exit IC pairs are evaluated as four-point ORS driving-hgv routes.
Every extra route preserves the exact registered HGV height/width/length/weight/axleload restrictions and ferry avoidance.
FINAL.36 time/distance detour limits and near-fast ranking remain authoritative; IC routes are candidates, never forced.
IC discovery failure safely falls back to the normal HGV route.
Overpass discovery is deferred until needed, briefly cached per warm instance, and extra ORS calls share the 30/minute warm-instance route-call guard.
No car or straight-line fallback was introduced.
